title: Fix wrong cart calculation when using cart rule with virtual products
issue_title: Major bug with Virtual Products
issue_body:
Hello folks,

I think I found a major bug in the handling of Virtual Products in Prestashop 1.7.

First off some background:

A while ago, I asked for help with an issue I have about the total being incorrectly calculated when using discount vouchers:

https://www.prestashop.com/forums/topic/866094-total-doesnt-consider-voucher/

As you can see, no one bothered to give me an answer as of now. Because this issue keep costing me money I kept investigating. I set up a test server using the latest Prestashop build 1.7.4.2 and installed my theme to it, but other than that didn't bother to add any modules or even products. I found that with the default products the discount voucher was displayed correctly:

https://i.imgur.com/xHBmxKR.jpg

After a lot of testing I found the culprit! When I changed the product type to "Virtual Product" the discount voucher stopped being calculated correctly:

https://i.imgur.com/n7wdC7d.jpg

https://i.imgur.com/HuRWDFw.jpg

I considered that this might be an issue related to my custom theme, but even using "Classic" that comes with 1.7.4.2 the problem still remained.

I really hope you could look into this matter and fix it for the next update and it would be great if someone could provide me some clues how I can remedy the problem in the meantime. As I mentioned, I am actually missing out on sales right now, because people can't use their discount codes.

Cheers

title: Robots should not index search content
issue_title: Google Search Console can complain of `Indexed, though blocked by robots.txt` for search results pages
issue_body:
Google Search Console can complain of `Indexed, though blocked by robots.txt` for PrestaShop search results pages if it finds such pages outside of its crawl instructions.  While crawling search pages is disallowed by a properly created `robots.txt`, they can still be indexed if they are found through other means, which is quite easy to do.  For example, if one uses tags on the front end, these can appear as search links which will get indexed.

Proposed fix:

`controllers/front/listing/SearchController.php` should always include `<meta name="robots" content="noindex">` in the page output in case a search engine finds a link to a search results page. 
 1.7.5.0 diff output below:

```diff
diff --git a/controllers/front/listing/SearchController.php b/controllers/front/listing/SearchController.php
index 400abc4d60..a31e9710d0 100644
--- a/controllers/front/listing/SearchController.php
+++ b/controllers/front/listing/SearchController.php
@@ -60,6 +60,15 @@ class SearchControllerCore extends ProductListingFrontController
         );
     }
 
+    public function getTemplateVarPage()
+    {
+        $page = parent::getTemplateVarPage();
+
+        $page['meta']['robots'] = 'noindex';
+
+        return $page;
+    }
+
     /**
      * Performs the search.
      */
```

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Include links to search results in your site, such as tags, like https://www.example.com/search?tag=headache on product, CMS or other pages.
1. Set up Google Search Console for https://www.example.com/
1. Wait for GSC to crawl and index your pages.
1. Observe the `Indexed, though blocked by robots.txt` warnings under Coverage for every encountered search link.

PrestaShop version: 1.7.5.0
PHP version: 7.0

title: Fix shipping cost becoming free if more than a half or available quantity ordered
issue_title: [BOOM-5163] Shipping costs become free when the product qty is beeing changed in BO order
issue_body:
> This issue has been migrated from the Forge. Read the [original ticket here](http://forge.prestashop.com/browse/BOOM-5163). - _**Reporter:**_ Connie - _**Created at:**_ Thu, 22 Mar 2018 17:55:10 +0100

This bug can be reproduces on clean install with demo goods.

Let we have some goods with total quantity 50 and simple carrier with some shipping cost.

The buyer creates an order and the shop calculates the shipping costs. For example he buys 20 qty. So in the BO one can see that in order qty 20 and 30 is available for the other buyers.

After that the buyer lets know that he wants to change quantyty and the new quantyty should be 30. Actually it could be any that would be equal or greater than quantity left.

The seller changes the quantuty to 30 and after that the shipping becomes free.

The problem is in the class Order method refreshShippingCost() line 2501. 

First in lines 2521-2524 fake cart gets zero quantyty and after that in lines 2526-2529 cart is sets with real quantity that the admin set.

If you have a look at the methor updateQty in the class Cart you can see that this method is invoked with default parametn operator = 'up'  so we get to the next if in the class Cart, line 1283 where the new quantity is been checked as the addon, not the new quantity. 
Since new quantity in not less that the quantity available for order the method updateQty returns false.

But this false result is not processed, see the class Order line 2528.

* How to reproduce the issue ? N/A

title: Solved problem with texture upload when attribute has hex color
issue_title: Uploading a texture to an attribute with a color code saved returns 404
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**
Uploading an image ("texture") to an attribute that have a color code saved will save the image value but remove the image which will return a 404 in the front office. Essentially it has saved the value for the attribute, but since the color code is set it removes the image. If we repeat the process, empty the color code, choose our image and then save, it now works.

**To Reproduce**

**[Part 1]** Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Set up an attribute for color
2. Add a color i.e. `#ffffff`
3. Set up some combinations using that attribute
4. Activate the attribute in the ps_facetedsearch module
5. Everything is working as expected

**[Part 2]** Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Edit that attribute and upload an image (keep the color code)
2. When you save you will not get any errors
3. Go back to and look at the ps_facetedsearch module
4. It will still be using the color code `#ffffff` but it will also be looking for the image since I _it's value_ seems to be stored in the database.
5. Check the browser console, it will be returning a 404 since it cant find the image. In my case it's looking for `.../img/co/8.jpg`.

**[Part 3]** Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Edit that same attribute
2. Notice that there is no image uploaded
3. Now empty the color value, select and image, and save.
4. Now everything works.

**Additionnal information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.4.2

PS 1.7.5 works really fast on every page, except this thing which is not actually a bug but needs a fix. 

Another thing:
I have 2 combinations: 'product size' and 'product colors'.  I recently installed a module from mypresta which adds product pictures to color combinations and after install those combinations (product colors) load almost instantly compared to 'product size' combinations. 
So after module install the color combinations load very fast compared to the size combinations which leads me to think that something can be done to load thinks quicker.

title: Unify algorithm for calculating average tax rate for products in a cart
issue_title: Unify algorithm for calculating average tax rate for products in a cart
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
There are currently two methods for calculating the average tax rate in a cart, `Cart::getTaxesAverageUsed()` and `$cart->getAverageProductsTaxRate()`. They used a different algorithm to calculate it, but it more or less ended up in "sum of all products without tax / sum of all taxes applied". This PR unifies the behavior and depreciates the static method.

### Steps to reproduce
Add many products to a cart, ideally with different tax rates, and with some reductions. In the order detail (FO), the reduction amount should be correct (or at least no different from before :trollface:)

title: Fix minimum order amount for secondary currency
issue_title: [BOOM-5355] minimum order in the second currency does not work
issue_body:
> This issue has been migrated from the Forge. Read the [original ticket here](http://forge.prestashop.com/browse/BOOM-5355). - _**Reporter:**_ Katrich - _**Created at:**_ Tue, 17 Apr 2018 16:29:27 +0200

Good afternoon. Faced the problem that when ordering in a currency different from the main one (for example, the basic dollar and the second hryvnia) with the minimum order of $ 15, the basket misses orders in the second currency for less than 15 dollars (in UAH it is 480 hryvnia) and in the basket shows the wrong amount of the minimum order. Here is the message "For the order to be accepted, its minimum amount should be 10 613.40 UAH. Now the amount of your order is 0.00 UAH"

* How to reproduce the issue ? Create an order for 500 hryvnia, which is 18 dollars, and we have a minimum order placed in the admin panel at 15 dollars
--------------------------
-Steps to reproduce :
1-Install PS 1.7.3.1. with English language / France country
2-Set "Default currency" to US Dollar
3-Import the Ukraine package
4-Set "Minimum purchase total required in order to validate the order" to 15$
*First issue:
In FO add to the cart a product with "10.80 $"
-try with Currency "USD $" => an alert is displayed "A minimum shopping cart total of $15.00 " => OK
-try with Currency "UAH ₴" => the alert disappear
*Second issue
In FO add to the cart a product with "0.01$"
-Navigate to the cart page, change to Currency "UAH ₴" => Total (tax incl.)UAH0.26 => an alert is displayed "A minimum shopping cart total of UAH10,186.86 (tax excl.) is required to validate your order. Current cart total is UAH6.78 (tax excl.).. => UAH6.78 not correct.

title: Fix HTML formated configuration not saved
issue_title: Fix HTML formated configuration not saved
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
HTML configuration is not authorized and thus not saved if the last field to be saved doesn't have any validation. This was caused by an unnecessary isset.

### Steps to reproduce
In a back-office controller create a configuration form with two fields. A textareaLang with a isCleanHtml validation and the autoload_rte flag and a second field of any type but with no validation set. Type some riche text in the first field and save. The HTML will be saved properly.
